requirements.name: A document-level FADED flag does not retire these entries
requirements.classification: Concrete historical loader/retirement mismatch; live activation not established
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: Six recovered syntax versions put STATE: FADED in the header before the first ESSENCE. The inspected core splits at ESSENCE, skips non-entry blocks, then checks FADED only inside an entry. The newest syntax document therefore admits all13 entries, including its authored turn procedure, under that exact admission predicate. Context admits12 and linguistics56 entries. This is a pure-text predicate receipt, not execution of the product loader.
requirements.current_disposition: The earliest recovered syntax version has no FADED header. The later marker and actual loader behavior disagree. The original intent/approval and complete call graph remain unverified. This expands the already identified LFR header-scope failure to a concrete cognitive-syntax family; it is not an additional unique defect or proof of current ArcLoom invocation.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Exclude the incompatible corpus controller from pupil decision authority. For any separately authorized external reader, define document-level retirement as input admission and verify it at the actual loader and consumer; do not wire the retired policy into native cognition. Preserve predecessor files and evidence of prior use.

requirements.name: Conversation is supplied by a fixed move program, not acquired syntax
requirements.classification: Authored decision policy and specification/implementation mismatch
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: The syntax prose enumerates five kinds of turn and progressively replaces a best-reply rule with filtering, counting what opens, greatest selection and joints. The inspected saying.Thread instead invokes12 named moves in a fixed list. It supplies greetings, sense thresholds (near>=3, at most four marks), fixed role ordering, a six-output repetition window and the literal ground: none fallback. Its state is Python subject/last-doing/sets/lists. The source asserts none of the words or sentences are its own, but the mechanism contains authored selection and formatting.
requirements.current_disposition: These are separate-fabric source findings, already related to LFR/LVR policy records; the eleven historical documents do not prove current pupil activation. A deterministic authored program is neither ML by default nor native experience-driven cognition. The phrase five move kinds is a proposed ontology, not a physical limit on conversation.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Retain honest diagnostic readers only at explicitly external scope. Retire their answer authority from the pupil. Require a direct native mechanism for retained sensory relations and endogenous articulation; do not tune the move list, rarity, thresholds, or sentence templates to obtain a speech pass.

requirements.name: Context requirements conflict with unconditional recency and one-subject state
requirements.classification: Useful requirements mixed with unsupported universal rules
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: Syntax says a standing question persists until closed and the thread never restarts. Context says the most recent turn dominates, a three-turn-late answer reaches a question nobody holds, and the older version forbids a thin reply reaching past intervening turns. These are different policies, not derived time constants. The source Thread holds one subject and last doing; those variables do not establish multimodal episodic context, speaker attribution, body need, temporal order or the story of experience.
requirements.current_disposition: Contextual disambiguation, common ground, clarification, attribution and truthful uncertainty are useful requirements. Assertions that surroundings always eliminate all but one meaning, or that a spoken frame resets every later interpretation, are not demonstrated physical laws. No current forgetting rate or live latency is measured here.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Specify retained episode relations and measured physical decay/consolidation separately from dialogue display state. Keep original uncertainty and source attribution. Context must influence native recall through sensed and retained state; never supply the intended meaning as hidden metadata or a hardcoded recency winner.

requirements.name: Linguistic prose is not an empirical law or an ArcLoom feasibility theorem
requirements.classification: Unsupported scientific authority and scope overreach
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: The linguistic corpus presents sweeping claims without cited experimental derivations: categories fixed in the first year, no production of an unheard distinction, no fluency from full construction, word changes applying everywhere, no grammar without stored classes, a ten-thousand-year reconstruction boundary, and one store for everything. It also warns that language universals exceed biased evidence. The abstract recursive-grammar discussion concerns a formal description, not unlimited finite hardware capacity.
requirements.current_disposition: This audit records these as unverified claims in the source, not a comprehensive external review of linguistics or a finding that every statement is false. A description of human behavior does not prove the necessity, impossibility, speed or sufficiency of a particular ArcLoom mechanism. Deleting CANNOT text does not authenticate the retained prose.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Preserve this material as attributed, unqualified external curriculum. Before any biological claim becomes a design premise, provide its primary evidence, exact scope and the functional mapping to approved bounded state dynamics. Keep a missing mechanism or capacity bound explicit; do not use prose to justify a dictionary, canned chunk or purported impossibility.

requirements.name: Learned reusable formations must be distinguished from supplied language pieces
requirements.classification: Retained useful functional requirements; missing native causal implementation proof
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: The linguistic text distinguishes sound categories from pressure, words from role structure, learned reusable phrases from composition, lexical labels from the wider system of distinctions, and sensory channels from language function. Those distinctions can guide falsifiers. They do not define DSF-to-neuron transitions, plastic contact changes, consolidation, recall, planning, or vocal acquisition. The source statement that fluency uses stored chunks does not authorize manually installed greetings or word-to-gesture tables.
requirements.current_disposition: The corpus is external authored text. Its mention of signed language is not evidence that the current body supports signing. Its use of field, category and store is not automatically the project DSF, post-quiescence neuronal formation or canonical checkpoint. No field is numerically evaluated here; the separate word-mask reader is a lexical projection rather than full seven-field DSF plus global S(UF).
requirements.lawful_remedy: Map each claimed language function to sensory acquisition, retained native state, later causal use and the actual body channel. Preserve genuinely acquired reusable formations and measured improvements. Leave an absent mapping open rather than inserting labels, phrase lists, universal grammar rules or native-sounding terminology.

requirements.name: Removed prohibitions and changing rules require separate migration judgments
requirements.classification: Mixed evolution; neither blanket restoration nor blanket improvement established
requirements.historical_requirement_or_mechanism: All eleven versions were read through855 latest lines and85 unique predecessor passages/307 lines. Syntax progresses from best selection to repeated filtering and joints; its retirement flag appears after the earliest version. The later constraints-are-gone revision removes CANNOT passages from all three families while retaining positive prose. The inspected core still parses CANNOT into impossible masks and requires/excludes laws. Such removal can change that reader, not just documentation wording.
requirements.current_disposition: Many removed prohibitions are overbroad; some preserve valuable evidence/continuity boundaries. No original per-clause ratification, matched execution before/after, or proven live migration follows from commit messages. Current consumer closure remains open. This is a scoped continuation of the earlier CANNOT-removal finding, not proof that all removed constraints must return.
requirements.lawful_remedy: Preserve every predecessor and classify each change by authority, semantic effect, retained state and evidence of benefit. Carry legitimate invariants into approved native specifications; retire incompatible lexical decision rules. Do not restore the whole corpus or label mass deletion a physical improvement without evidence.
